main.description: Tsunami-specific facts of a hazard notice. Used together with dev.jisaku.mosimo.hazard.

arrival.description: Earliest (expected) arrival in the post's area. UTC with an uppercase Z suffix. Omit when only qualitative.

height.description: Largest wave height for the post's area. Qualitative or open-ended notations stay in text; never put a range bound in value.

text.description: Original notation such as 巨大 or 10m超.
